title: Devils vs. Islanders: What Will Happen in the Opener

subtitle: The matchup between New Jersey and New York promises surprises and twists

author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The matchup between the New Jersey Devils and the New York Islanders, scheduled for 7:30 PM, is already on the radar of hockey fans. The game is the second of the season and promises to reveal who has the best line chemistry and who can surprise on the ice.

Recent History Between the Teams

The Islanders won last season's series 7-0-1, while the Devils have a 0-1-0 record at the start of the new campaign. The last matchup, in 2025-26, was marked by a 9-0 loss for the Devils in Long Island.

Islanders' Forward Line

In their first game of the season, the Islanders relied on their top line, led by Emil Heineman, Bo Horvat, and Kyle Palmieri. In Friday's practice, Heineman was promoted to the top line in the second half, showing the search for chemistry among the forwards. Simon Holmström, who has previously played with JG Pageau, was also featured on the second line alongside Anthony Duclair.

Devils' Defense and Goaltending

The Devils, on the other hand, relied on Nico Daws in goal, who has 24 wins, 24 losses, and 1 tie in his career. Daws has a 2.96 GAA and a .898 save percentage. On defense, the team has Nico Hischier, who signed a five-year extension, and other players who were traded or acquired in the offseason.

Coaches' Strategies and Adjustments

Islanders head coach Pete DeBoer said he is looking for combinations that work well on the lines without changing the lineup too much. Meanwhile, the Devils, under new general manager Sunny Mehta, made several trades, including the arrival of Luke Evangelista and the signing of Anthony Mantha.

Featured Players

Matthew Schaefer, the 19-year-old young defenseman, is the team's first alternate captain and has already scored 59 points this season. He is considered one of the most exciting players to watch in games. In New Jersey, forward Luke Hughes, who scored the game-winning goal in the season opener, is a central figure on offense.

Expectations for the Game

Fans expect the Devils to try to overcome their historic performance against the Islanders, while the Islanders look to keep their winning streak alive. The matchup promises to be decisive for anyone wanting to start the season strong.
